decisions: No new generic validators or unrelated features before Pattern #1 and Pattern #2 are executable.
Default user-visible preset may never be knowingly rejected; constrain unsupported breadth instead of exposing broken combinations.

Pattern #2 should be the simplest defensible deterministic crochet family, likely a basic joined-round circle/coaster or comparably simple construction, chosen for fastest trustworthy end-to-end completion.
Do not claim 100% execution without actual evidence.
